aiInfra.headline: TSMC Q3: revenue US$46.72B (above $44.6–45.8B guide), GM 66.4% (−1.3pt on N2 ramp), EPS NT$29.43 (+68.7% y/y). Q4 guide $52.3–54.3B (~+14% q/q), GM 65–67%. 2026 capex reiterated $60–64B; cited agentic AI demand.
aiInfra.why: Clean beat-and-raise on AI demand; capex not cut. Supports NVDA/MU/hyperscaler demand thesis.

aiInfra.headline: TSM ADR still fell −1.80% to $422.25 on the beat; SOX −0.88%, SOXX down an eighth straight day (first since 2015, >15% over the run). NVDA $217.23 (−1.84%).
aiInfra.why: Good news isn't being bought yet; the group is trading on financing/rates, not orders.

aiInfra.headline: Memory: SK Hynix −26%, Samsung −22%, MU ~−11% over five days on CXMT's denser server-DRAM plan plus a Maeil column warning of 2029 oversupply (Musk: China 'will be making a LOT of RAM in 2028'). Rosenblatt and Quilter doubt CXMT scales; Counterpoint sees 2028 DRAM −23% but still ~230% above 2025.
aiInfra.why: The memory bear case is long-dated and opinion-led; LTAs with prepayments dampen any down-cycle.

aiInfra.headline: SK Hynix Thu close ₩1,262,000 (−11.06%), Samsung ₩210,000 (−9.48%), KOSPI 5,554.22 (−7.57%, weakest since 7 Apr). Fri live ~10:04 KST: SK ₩1,292,500 (+2.42%), Samsung +1.79%, KOSPI +2.56%; foreigners still net selling. MU closed +1.87% at $931.24.
aiInfra.why: First bounce after a 7-day slide; foreign selling not yet reversed. SK Q3 on 27 Oct is the next hard data.

fearGreed.read: CNN 31.5 Fear (API rating 'fear'), stamp 2026-10-15T23:59:53Z (Thu close = 07:59 WITA Fri). Prior digest 32.4 Fear; prev close 32.3, 1-wk 39.8, 1-mo 28.0. Stabilizing in Fear, not capitulating; S&P up but tech rotation kept sentiment pinned.

macro.headline: Sep PPI +1.3% m/m, +6.3% y/y (vs 0.6% / 5.5% est), biggest since 2022; core +0.7% / 5.0%. Retail sales +0.8% but control group only +0.1% (vs 0.3%).
macro.why: Second hot inflation print in two days, but a weak real consumer limits how hawkish the Fed can go.

macro.headline: October-hike odds briefly spiked then retreated below 30% (CME/Kalshi ~27–29%), vs ~33% after CPI. 10Y fell to 5.09% (−10bp).
macro.why: Falling yields are the key relief for debt-funded neoclouds like NBIS.

macro.headline: Thu: Dow +1.08% to 52,177.69, S&P +0.33% to 7,744.06, Nasdaq +0.08% (was −1.4% intraday); VIX 16.46. Rotation out of tech into healthcare/value; Nasdaq-100 futures −0.2% overnight.
macro.why: Broad tape stabilized; AI complex is the funding source for the rotation.

macro.headline: Today 11:30 WITA: Fed Chair Warsh with IMF MD Georgieva in Bangkok, last big Fed voice before the 17 Oct blackout. WTI $95.82 / Brent $105.33 in Asia; DXY 102.04; USDTHB 33.51; USDKRW 1,346.6.
macro.why: Warsh's read on two hot prints sets the tone into FOMC 27–28 Oct.

nbis.headline: Thu cash $188.41 (+1.29% / +$2.40 vs $186.01); open $175.48, intraday low $163.36 (−12%) then recovered; vol ~44–47M. Overnight ~$187.42 (−0.53%). Cap $51.22B; ≈ THB 6,314/sh at 33.51. Still −24.6% from 6 Oct $249.87.
nbis.why: Hammer-style reversal off the lows on heavy volume; no FLAG. Next support cited near the 200-day ~$173.

nbis.headline: Nebius disclosed agreements with several UK AI labs (EMEA chief Gary Tierney); no counterparties or contract values given. Rotterdam VOLT 600 MW site is still a letter of intent, not a signed offtake.
nbis.why: Demand signal, but nothing modelable. Do not count LOI capacity as contracted.

nbis.headline: Peer risk widened: SemiAnalysis reported outages, storage failures and GPU errors at IREN's British Columbia sites and said IREN has no live managed-cloud service; IREN fell. CoreWeave bounced +5.9% to $69.69 after Wed −15.5%.
nbis.why: Neocloud quality/credit is now being priced name by name; Nebius's investment-grade-backed $775M loan at SOFR+250 is the differentiator to watch.

nbis.headline: New Form 144: Director John W. Boynton IV Trust proposed sale of 7,260 sh (~$1.35M), filed 15 Oct. No new issuer 6-K since 1 Oct.
nbis.why: Immaterial. No dilution, convert or guidance change.

soWhat: NBIS +1.3% to $188.41 after a $163 intraday low; reversal but still −25% from 6 Oct. No new filing; UK lab deals have no values. No FLAG.
TSMC beat and raised (Q4 ~$53B, capex $60–64B intact) yet TSM fell; demand is fine, the market is repricing financing risk.
Memory bounce: SK +2.4% live after −11%, MU +1.9%. Bear case is a 2029 oversupply column plus CXMT; SK Q3 27 Oct.
Hot PPI but yields fell 10bp and hike odds back under 30%. F&G 31.5 Fear (from 32.4). Warsh speaks 11:30 WITA today.
